call_points.text: Advertising & promotion investments increased by 150 bps YoY to c. 3.8% of revenues in Q2 FY27.
Capex intensity for FY27 and FY28 will be less than half of past levels, reserved mainly for mould replacement and select innovations.
Entered the wires category in February 2026, receiving strong initial market response.
Took price increases of 3-10% in Q4, another 3-10% in April, and further hikes in May to offset commodity inflation.
Long-term ambition in Consumer Products is to grow faster than mid-single-digit market growth and achieve industry-average EBIT margins of 6-9%.
Strong cash position maintained with cash, equivalents, and surplus investments of ₹934 Cr and negative working capital.
Operating cash flow for FY26 reached ₹619 Cr, supported by reduction in debtors and inventory levels.
General Trade dropped approximately 2% YoY while Alternate channels remained flat.

operating_notes.text: Final dividend of ₹3.00 per share recommended for FY26.
Entered the wires market in February 2026 under Lighting Solutions vertical.
Took 3-10% price increases in Q4FY26, another 3-10% in April 2026, and further hikes in May 2026 to offset commodity inflation.
Generated ~₹400 Cr operating cash flow in Q4FY26 through working capital reduction across inventory and receivables.
Company decided to enter the 'Cables' category under its Lighting Solutions segment to capture growing industry demand.
Received adverse appellate tax order for FY 2019-20 from West Bengal authority of ₹6.27 crore including ₹0.32 crore penalty.
Q2FY27 revenue grew 1.5% YoY to ₹1,123.32 Cr while PAT rose 164.7% YoY to ₹26.10 Cr.
H1FY27 operating cash flow was -₹49.78 Cr against +₹11.92 Cr in H1FY26, with inventories at ₹705.31 Cr against ₹533.52 Cr at 31-Mar-26.
Consumer Products Q2FY27 EBIT was ₹34.07 Cr against ₹7.44 Cr a year ago; Lighting Solutions EBIT was ₹8.39 Cr against ₹21.77 Cr.
Received a ₹112.32 Cr income tax demand for AY 2019-20 on account of disallowance of expenses; management plans to appeal.

timeline.summary: On 23 April 2026, Bajaj Electricals announced a favourable appellate order reducing its FY 2018-19 GST demand from ₹83.78 lakh to ₹3.61 lakh.
CRISIL reaffirmed ratings on ₹1,400 Cr bank facilities at AA-/Stable/A1+ and withdrew A1+ on ₹600 Cr proposed limits.
Niraj Bajaj (Promoter Group) declared no encumbrances on Bajaj Electricals shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI Regn 31(4).
Bajaj Electricals announced that shareholders approved independent director appointment and remuneration during profit inadequacy via postal ballot.
On May 9, 2026, Bajaj Electricals announced that the West Bengal appellate authority upheld a ₹2.69 Cr GST and penalty assessment order for FY2020-21.
On 11 May 2026, Bajaj Electricals announced a favourable appellate order dropping its FY 2019-20 GST demand of ₹22.89 lakh.
Bajaj Electricals Limited cancels Q4FY26 earnings call on May 15, 2026, due to technical issues; rescheduling in progress.
Bajaj Electricals Limited made its Q4FY26 earnings call recording available on May 20, 2026, via its website.
Bajaj Electricals conducted its rescheduled Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for lower FY27-28 capex and CP segment recovery.
Bajaj Electricals announced its entry into the 'Cables' category under its Lighting Solutions segment.
Bajaj Electricals received an adverse appellate tax order of ₹6.27 crore for FY 2019-20 from West Bengal authorities on October 12, 2026.
Bajaj Electricals Limited revised intimation with updated link for the Q2FY27 Earnings Call scheduled on October 28, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,123.32 Cr (+1.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹26.1 Cr (+164.7% YoY) (Q2FY26 includes ₹4.77 Cr from discontinued operations).
Bajaj Electricals Limited shared the audio recording of its Q2FY27 Earnings Call held on October 28, 2026, at 4:30 PM (IST) via its website.
Bajaj Electricals received a ₹112.32 Cr income tax demand for AY 2019-20 due to expense disallowances.

status_history.evidence: Management stated channel stock correction is complete except for coolers, but BLDC fan underperformance remains a work in progress.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend and fund raising

status_history.evidence: CP segment reported a loss in Q4 due to operating deleverage, but management targets long-term recovery to 6-9% EBIT margin.

watchlist.text: Consumer Products margin recovery and fan market share

watchlist.response: Acknowledged weakness in BLDC fans and stated that teams are working to bridge product and price-point gaps over the next 12 months.
watchlist.text: Losing market share in fans and slow scale-up of BLDC fans portfolio

watchlist.response: Shifted approach to design innovations at the right price points and margins so that new product launches do not dilute overall P&L.
watchlist.text: Inability to translate past product development investments into financial results
Continuation of Mr. Shekhar Bajaj as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director and Chairman Emeritus, by Special Resolution through Postal Ballot
